notes.subject: זֹאת לֹא זֹאת
notes.rationale: Ndeto igĩcokanĩria 'ũguo — ti — ũguo': huo mũhanyũkĩre wa gũtekũka ndũngĩhoota o na mũthemba mweya wa Gĩkũyũ.

notes.subject: השפלה/הגבה
notes.rationale: Kwihorerwo kwa kĩngerethi: הגבה והשפיל nĩmacokanagia hamwe — ũrĩa ũrĩ thaatho agĩigua igũrũ, ũrĩa ũrĩ igũrũ agĩkũũra thĩ.

notes.subject: haignĩrya ya njorereria
notes.rationale: Matukũ ma andũ aingĩ (KJV, Geneva) maarĩ mugambo ũrĩa ndũrĩ ũhoro-inĩ ici kana haandĩkĩre handũ ĩngĩ kana ithenya rĩa ndemwa cia Kĩhibirania; JPS nĩguo ĩrĩ na ũhoro wa ma wa thutha.

notes.subject: kũ andũ a Yuda
notes.rationale: Ciugo icio nĩciarĩrĩria mwathi wa Yuda mũthenya ũcio; kũingĩria na kũnyanyithia kwa mũhianĩre-inĩ ũcio nĩkuo kũrĩhĩtie.

translation: Ũguo Adonai Yahwe oigĩte: Haania kĩguni-kĩa-mwathi, na hĩgũrũra ⟨kĩũrũnga⟩; ũguo ti ũguo: ũrĩ o thaatho mũingĩrie, na ũrĩ igũrũ mũnyanyithie.
